payload.title: Set up a new fgOS runner executor named 'glm' that reuses the 'claude' CLI as its command, but…
payload.description: Set up a new fgOS runner executor named 'glm' that reuses the 'claude' CLI as its command, but routes to the GLM 5.2 model (zai/GLM) via OpenRouter instead of Anthropic's real API. Needs: (1) a per-executor environment-variable override in the runner config schema (dispatch/config.mjs's executor-entry validation + dispatch/transport.mjs's cliSpawnAdapter currently always spawns with env:{...process.env} unmodified -- no way today to give one executor its own env distinct from the default 'claude' executor) so 'glm' can set the OpenRouter-compatible base-url/auth-token/model env vars without affecting the default 'claude' executor's real Anthropic calls; (2) register 'glm' in .fgos/config.json's runner.executors, kind agent, command 'claude', with its own env block; (3) the OpenRouter API key must be stored OUTSIDE any git-tracked file (never in .fgos/config.json, never in any committed config) -- read from a local untracked env var/secrets file at spawn time, only the env-var NAME committed, never the value. User already has a live OpenRouter key ready to wire in during implementation (to be placed in an untracked location, not passed through this work item's own text).
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

payload.outcome: Confirmed claude CLI ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/AUTH_TOKEN/MODEL routes to OpenRouter (real, documented); z-ai/glm-5.2 is a real OpenRouter model id; fgOS runner config has no per-executor env override today (dispatch/config.mjs + transport.mjs confirmed) -- clear scope for a new optional env field.

payload.title: resolve.mjs's cross-provider gate (line ~322, allowCrossProvider check) only inspects…
payload.description: resolve.mjs's cross-provider gate (line ~322, allowCrossProvider check) only inspects executor.command against CLAUDE_CLI_COMMANDS -- it has no awareness that an executor's own env override (e.g. ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) can route prompt content to a real non-Claude backend while command stays 'claude'. Found while adding the 'glm' executor (tsk-gb3, routes through OpenRouter/Z.ai via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL while command='claude'), which passes this gate silently even though its prompt content genuinely leaves the Claude ecosystem -- exactly what the gate's own error message says it exists to catch. Needs a decision on whether/how the gate should also inspect an executor's env block for a backend-redirecting var, and what counts as 'leaves the ecosystem' once env overrides exist.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

patch.action: Implement plan.md: add executors.<id>.env (config.mjs) with a ${VAR} substitution against process.env (transport.mjs, never a shell), register executors.glm in .fgos/config.json routing claude CLI through OpenRouter's z-ai/glm-5.2, add test cases to dispatch.test.mjs, keep the real OpenRouter key out of every git-tracked file.
